enchantment.ethereal_enchantments:oblite: With enchantments fully understood, most ancients were satisfied with the magic they had unlocked. However, some of them were not satisfied and wanted more. In an attempt to bypass the normal laws of enchanting, this splinter group's plan backfired, creating the Curse of Obliteration. This Curse is so unstable that it decays enchantments when the tool is held by a living thing.

§sCurse of Obliteration§r

Max Level: IV

Compatible with: Anything

When an item is held in a player's inventory, the enchantments on that item decay over time, level by level.
enchantment.ethereal_enchantments:afflic: The development of potions in ancient times led to a renaissance—but it also led to wars much more destructive than anything that had come before. In an attempt to counteract potion-wielding warriors, ancient enchanters developed Affliction, an enchantment that transfers negative status effects from the wielder to the victim.

§sAffliction§r

Max Level: III

Compatible with: Melee Weapons and Tridents

Transfers negative status effects from the attacker to the victim. Higher levels transfer a larger proportion of the effect.
enchantment.ethereal_enchantments:atroph: Not all enchantments are created equal—some are created on accident. Unbreaking is one of the most essential enchantments to modern life, but it is not perfect. When an Unbreaking enchantment fails to materialize, the end result is the Curse of Atrophy, a curse which increases the rate at which durability is lost.

§sCurse of Atrophy§r

Max Level: V

Compatible with: Anything

Increases the rate at which durability is lost. Each level corresponds to one extra loss of durability upon use.
enchantment.ethereal_enchantments.brutal: Sharpness increases damage output, but it doesn't increase it enough for some. Smite and Bane of Arthropods were developed to address Sharpness' limitations, but they only work against certain enemies. In an attempt to bring Smite and Bane of Arthropods' increased damage output, Brutality was crafted. Brutality deals more damage than Sharpness against all enemies—at the cost of also damaging the wielder.

§sBrutality§r

Max Level: V

Compatible with: Melee Weapons

Increases damage output by 2.5 x level, but damages the wielder by 1 x level (magic damage) for every attack.
enchantment.ethereal_enchantments:hurric: The sea harbors many horrors, but to sailors there is one terror greater than them all: storms. Hurricane captures the ocean's natural meteorological ferocity by creating a large wind burst at the location of every Trident thrown.

§sHurricane§r

Max Level: III

Compatible with: Trident

Creates a wind burst at the location of thrown tridents (hitting blocks or entities) and when attacking entities in melee combat.
enchantment.ethereal_enchantments:knowle: The earliest enchanters ran into a bottleneck when first developing their craft—without a source of experience, they could not enchant. To address this limitation, Knowledge was created—by interfacing with the intrinsic magic of the world, this enchantment increases the rate at which experience is produced by mining and slaying enemies.

§sKnowledge§r

Max Level: III

Compatible with: Melee weapons and tools

Increases experience dropped by blocks and entities. Each level adds 1/3 as much experience.
